subdivision_of_building: in association with use of ground floor restaurant
description: Proposed ssiting of extraction equipment to rear elevation.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Location plan; Planning statement ref. hk/S&M/Blmsbry/APC/02.04.26 dated 2 April 2026 prepared by RR Planning Ltd.; Fire Risk Assessment dated 16 March 2026 prepared by Ace Fire Midlands Ltd.; Drawing Number 03; Drawing Number 02; Drawing Number 01; Specification report ref. OD657831.2 dated 13/03/2026 prepared by Fan Rescue Ltd.; Kitchen extraction, kitchen fresh air and high level odour control system proposal ref. P1184582201 dated 18th March 2026 prepared by Fan Rescue Ltd.; Noise Impact Assessment Issue 01 dated 17th March 2026 prepared by DAA Group; Document tilted 'Recirculation and filtration systems' prepared by Purified Air; Document titled 'Longar type 16 standard and high capacity HEPA filters' prepared by Longar Industries Limited; GA/009/892; Document of specifications of metal cased discarbs ref. 02/09 prepared by AirClean; Document of specifications of fans titled 'SuperLite - JM Aerofoil Accessories'.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. The proposed external extraction equipment including ductwork to rear elevation shall be painted in black colour. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development with specified noise mitigation hereby approved shall be lower than the typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, by 15dBA where the source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with machinery operating at maximum capacity and thereafter be permanently retained.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from mechanical installations/ equipment in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 6 - The installation, operation, and maintenance of the odour abatement equipment and extract system, including the height of the extract duct and discharge outlet, shall be in accordance with the technical guidance set out in 'EMAQ+Control of Odour and Noise from Commercial Kitchen Exhaust Systems.' Approved details shall be implemented prior to the commencement of the use and thereafter be permanently retained.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by cooking odour.
